logs.title: Server Logs
logs.filterHint: Search and level filters apply to this page only. They do not fetch older history.
logs.timezoneHint: Timestamps are shown as TeamSpeak wrote them. WebQuery does not report whether the server log zone is UTC or local.

pageMeta.newestEnd: Newest page · end of available cursor
pageMeta.olderEnd_one: Older page {{count}} · end of available cursor
pageMeta.olderEnd_other: Older page {{count}} · end of available cursor

logs.countInstance: {{filtered}} of {{total}} entries on this page · instance logfile
logs.countVirtualServer: {{filtered}} of {{total}} entries on this page · VS {{sid}}

scope.instance: Instance log (not scoped to the selected virtual server)

empty.noOlder: No older log entries for this cursor. Refresh for the newest page if the log rotated.
empty.instanceEmpty: Instance log returned no entries. The TeamSpeak instance logfile may be empty, or instance logview is unavailable for this connection.
empty.virtualServerEmpty: No virtual server log entries on this page.

errors.loadFailed: Could not load server logs from TeamSpeak.
errors.logviewIo: TeamSpeak could not read its logfile (permissions, lock, or rotation). Manager is connected — use Retry once after a few seconds, or check the TeamSpeak logs volume.
errors.logviewIoBackground: TeamSpeak could not read its logfile. The last successful page is still displayed — Retry once; do not leave this page auto-refreshing.
errors.refreshFailed: Log refresh failed. The last successful page is still displayed.
errors.scopeMismatch: Log scope response did not match the selected Instance / Virtual server mode. Refresh to reload.
errors.starting: TeamSpeak Query is still coming up after startup. Wait a moment and retry.
errors.startingBackground: TeamSpeak Query is still starting. Log data may be incomplete until it comes online.

refresh.idleNewest: Newest log page up to date

audit.title: Administrative Audit
audit.description: Manager-initiated admin actions only — separate from TeamSpeak client activity and Server Logs. Retention: {{days}} days or {{rows}} rows (whichever first). Records cannot be deleted from this UI.

empty.title: No audit events yet
empty.description: Kick, ban, connection, flow, user, and settings mutations that are instrumented will appear here.

errors.refreshFailed: Audit refresh failed. The last successful page is still displayed.
errors.loadFailed: Failed to load audit history. Confirm you are signed in as an admin.

actions.listener_remote_auth_failed: Listener remote: refused access (total for 5 minutes)
actions.listener_remote_rate_limited: Listener remote: rate limited (total for 5 minutes)

journal.title: Activity Journal
journal.description: Opt-in TeamSpeak join/leave history for this connection and virtual server. Identity fields are allow-listed (no IPs or chat). Retention: {{days}}d / {{perSid}} per connection-SID / {{global}} global.
journal.selectDescription: Select a connection and virtual server to view the activity journal.
journal.historyError: Could not load activity journal history.
journal.historyRefreshError: History refresh failed. The last successful page is still displayed.

empty.unknown: No journal entries on this page. Capture status is not known yet.
empty.enabled: No journal entries yet for this context.
empty.disabled: Capture is disabled. Enable capture to record joins and leaves.

mediaDiagnostics.title: Media diagnostics
mediaDiagnostics.description: Check media tools, audio encoding, and sidecar health.
mediaDiagnostics.copyFailed: Could not copy the diagnostic report
mediaDiagnostics.notChecked: Not checked. Use Refresh when this browser is online.
mediaDiagnostics.runFailed: Could not run media diagnostics. Use Refresh to retry.
mediaDiagnostics.stale: This report is stale. Use Refresh to probe again.

runtimeMedia.title: Runtime / media
runtimeMedia.notChecked: Not checked. Use Refresh to probe yt-dlp, ffmpeg, ffprobe, and the media sidecar.
runtimeMedia.runFailed: Could not run runtime diagnostics. Use Refresh to retry.
runtimeMedia.updateHintYtDlp: Bundled yt-dlp does not self-update at runtime — pull or rebuild the TS6 Manager image to refresh it.
runtimeMedia.updateHintSidecar: Video and IPTV streaming need a reachable media sidecar (Docker SIDECAR_URL or a local binary).

guidance.diagnosticReadDoesNotAuthorizeWrites: Confirms management read access only — not write authorization for kicks, bans, file changes, or settings.
guidance.diagnosticSuccessWithVersion: WebQuery read stages OK ({{version}}) — write actions still need their own permissions
guidance.diagnosticSuccessWithoutVersion: WebQuery read stages succeeded — write actions still need their own permissions
guidance.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete "{{name}}" ({{path}})? This cannot be undone. Browsing this folder does not confirm permission to create or delete files.

browse.sshRequired: File browsing requires SSH access because the TeamSpeak WebQuery HTTP API does not support file transfer commands. Configure SSH credentials (username and password) in server settings.
browse.sshDisconnected: SSH to TeamSpeak is temporarily disconnected (often after Query flood protection on startup). Wait a moment and retry — credentials are usually fine.
browse.sshFailed: Could not connect to TeamSpeak via SSH. Check the SSH credentials and port in server settings.
browse.permissionDenied: The Query identity lacks permission to list files in this channel. WebQuery read success does not grant file-transfer access.
browse.failed: Failed to load files. Ensure SSH credentials are configured in server settings.

create.sshRequired: Cannot create directories: SSH is required for file changes (WebQuery HTTP does not support ft* commands).
create.sshDisconnected: Cannot create directories: SSH is temporarily disconnected. Wait for reconnect and retry.
create.sshFailed: Cannot create directories: SSH connection failed. Check SSH credentials and port in server settings.
create.permissionDenied: Insufficient TeamSpeak permission to create directories. Listing this folder does not authorize writes — grant the Query identity the required file-transfer permissions.

delete.sshRequired: Cannot delete files: SSH is required for file changes (WebQuery HTTP does not support ft* commands).
delete.sshDisconnected: Cannot delete files: SSH is temporarily disconnected. Wait for reconnect and retry.
delete.sshFailed: Cannot delete files: SSH connection failed. Check SSH credentials and port in server settings.
delete.permissionDenied: Insufficient TeamSpeak permission to delete files. Listing this folder does not authorize writes — grant the Query identity the required file-transfer permissions.

sidecar_unavailable.title: Media sidecar unavailable
sidecar_unavailable.action: Check that the sidecar is running, then retry.

source_unavailable.title: The source could not be played

bot_not_connected.title: Bot is not connected
bot_not_connected.action: Start the bot, then try again.

unexpected_error.title: Something went wrong
unexpected_error.action: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the server logs.
